<!-- File purpose: Makes quality and security evidence part of every review. -->
## What changed?

Explain the user-facing or technical change and why it is needed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Java tests pass.
- [ ] Angular tests and production build pass.
- [ ] SonarQube Quality Gate is green.
- [ ] New SonarQube issues are fixed or justified in the PR discussion.
- [ ] Security Hotspots are reviewed, with no secrets committed.
- [ ] Deployment/rollback impact is documented when relevant.

## Reviewer approval

- [ ] Two reviewers approved, including the CODEOWNER.
- [ ] All requested changes and conversations are resolved.
